name: NetExplorer
description:
NetExplorer MCP connects your NetExplorer platform to Claude, so you can work with your documents using natural language — without leaving the conversation.
Once connected, Claude can search, read, and act on the files you already store in NetExplorer:

Find & retrieve — full-text and semantic search, search by name, by date, or by recent activity
Read & summarize — summarize a document, compare versions, answer questions across multiple files, download a file
Organize — create folders, rename, move or copy items, and save Claude's output straight back into NetExplorer
Share & collect — generate share links or send a file by email, and create deposit links to collect files from anyone (no account needed)

Built on the open MCP standard with OAuth 2.1, the connector is hosted by NetExplorer. Every user signs in with their own profile and acts strictly with their own permissions — admins decide whether read, write, and sharing are enabled. The connector never deletes anything, and your password is never seen by the AI.

_published_faq.name: How do I add NetExplorer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add NetExplorer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.netexplorer.io/t/files.netexplorer.pro/N5wMiVeEbXIvPU5GPtQTK0d62Fb4soelGQ5KClWe173/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the NetExplorer MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: NetExplorer lists 20 MCP tools, including browse_folder, copy, create_deposit_link, create_folder, create_upload_link, download_file, file_info, get_path, list_roots, move, read_file, and recent_files.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to NetExplorer?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to NetExplorer in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
NetExplorer requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
NetExplorer is developed by NetExplorer. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
